verdict.rationale: Brave's pricing page advertises "Up to $20 in free calls every month" with prepaid credits and no subscription, and the docs offer a quickstart and an in-browser playground for trying endpoints. Community reports confirm a free tier exists, but say its Terms of Use prohibit using responses for AI inference and that AI use requires a separate plan. That caveat limits free prototyping for AI and agent use cases. Missing for 10: documented free-tier quotas and rate limits, clear first-party terms on AI use of free credits, and hands-on corroboration of the free-credit experience.
